rule: New pins only where no identity-level catalog match AND an independently verified public name exists with coordinates. Personal licence-holder names are never used as the map name. Absence from WCLA never deletes an existing POI. Distance alone is not duplicate evidence; suppress only with same/similar name, same address, same centre/unit, same phone/site/provider ID, or clear rebrand/alias.
